description: This file defines the interface, constants, enums, classes, and data structures for handling RTSP (Real-Time Streaming Protocol) messages and interactions in a Miracast-related project. It includes declaration of the MiracastRTSPMsg class, which manages RTSP message exchange, session management, and configuration for Miracast streaming, along with various related enums and structs for parsing and processing RTSP messages.

classes.name: MiracastRTSPMsg
classes.description: A singleton class managing RTSP message creation, validation, and communication for Miracast streaming sessions.

methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of MiracastRTSPMsg.

methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of MiracastRTSPMsg.
